nom: Good Molecules Dark Spot Microdart Patches

segments.mature: One mature-adult reviewer feels the formula is not strong enough and recommends a derm-grade or higher-penetration alternative like Roc instead.

concerns.aging: A reviewer identifying as mid to mature felt the microdart formula lacked the strength or penetration needed for mature skin concerns and suggested a stronger alternative.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: two reviewers saw a noticeable lightening of dark or acne scars (one after four nights on cheeks, one on two spots), while one reviewer says the patches left new dark circles around a scar that had not faded after two days.

aspects.libelle: Left new dark discoloration around scar
Preference for a competing microdart brand

extraits.texte: For mid to mature adults you need something stronger, derm grade ingredients to really penetrate. This does not have that. You are better off spending more money and getting a product like Roc skincare even tone which says goes 10 layers deep or something similar.
After two days of using the pactches left dark circles around scar and hasnt gone away

They felt like they were going to work, but after applying to my bare face as soon as i try to put on any moisturizer on my face the patches begin to peel off immediately and became unusable. I perfer the Star micodart ones to these.
Ive been using this product on two spots ans i actively notice a difference

I've got some stubborn acne scarring on my cheeks, which has darkened since I've been tanning in the summer. These patches worked surprisingly well. After 4 nights of use, I saw a significant difference in the darkness of the spots.

reserve: Only five reviews are available and most do not state the reviewer's skin type, so segment-level conclusions beyond mature skin are not supported.
